correctness.rationale: The Rota-Baxter identity is bilinear in the two inputs, so the 16 matrix-unit pairs are an exhaustive test for each of the 2^16 linear maps. Every accepted map is separately rechecked on all 256 ordered element pairs. Minimal polynomials, all algebra automorphisms, and all orbit closures under automorphisms, transpose, and phi are computed exactly over F_2. The verifier reports 28/110 total operators, 6/24 extremals, automorphism-orbit sizes (3,3)/(6,6,6,6), and full-equivalence orbit sizes 6/24.

value.rationale: The smallest characteristic-two matrix algebra is a natural boundary omitted by the nearby classifications. The result does more than reproduce an operator: it exhaustively determines extremal degree and exact orbit structure, confirms one full extremal equivalence class per weight, and proves that transpose and phi are genuinely needed to recover that rigidity from the finer automorphism-conjugacy classification. This directly informs possible positive-characteristic extensions of the 2026 extremal theorem.
